facts.text: The University of the Ozarks offers the Jones Learning Center, a comprehensive support program for students with documented learning disabilities, AD/HD, or Autism Spectrum Disorder.

sources.title: Jones Learning Center - University of the Ozarks
sources.quote: The Jones Learning Center (JLC) is designed to serve students with documented learning disabilities, Attention Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (AD/HD), or Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) with average or above average intellectual abilities.
